B1-01.guard_minimum: 2 women per arm after the cut for the Welch t statistic (faulty: 2 active-arm women for the paired t statistic)

B1-02.guard_minimum: 2 women per group for the two-sample (Welch) t statistic

B1-03.guard_minimum: 2 patients after the cut for the paired t statistic

B1-04.guard_minimum: at least 1 voxel per participant and at least 2 participants with a non-empty region (paired t across participants needs 2)

B1-05.guard_minimum: at least 1 voxel selected and at least 2 participants in the estimation half (one-sample t needs 2)

B1-06.guard_minimum: at least 1 voxel selected and at least 3 trials in the test half (a slope p value needs 3 points)

B1-07.guard_minimum: at least 1 neuron selected (a mean is defined from 1) and at least 2 trials per stimulus in each half

B1-08.guard_minimum: at least 1 electrode selected and at least 3 trials in the test half (R-squared of a one-predictor regression needs 3 points), both conditions present

B1-09.guard_minimum: at least 1 voxel selected and at least 3 participants (a correlation needs 3 pairs)

B1-10.guard_minimum: 2 neurons per third for the Welch t statistic

B1-11.guard_minimum: 2 participants per group in the test half (Welch t needs 2 per group)

B1-12.guard_minimum: 1 patient after the cut (a proportion is defined from 1)

B2-01.guard_minimum: at least 1 positive and 1 negative row among the scored rows (smallest size at which AUC is defined); in each training fold at least 2 rows per class.

B2-02.guard_minimum: at least 1 positive row in the held-out set to define sensitivity (and at least 2 positive rows in the data before oversampling); in each training fold at least 2 rows per class.

B2-03.guard_minimum: at least 1 row of each class in the held-out set (balanced accuracy needs both sensitivity and specificity); in each training fold at least 2 rows per class.

B2-04.guard_minimum: at least 1 row in the scored later block (accuracy defined for 1 row); at least 2 rows per class in the fitting block.

B2-05.guard_minimum: at least 2 weeks in the scored block with non-zero variance of demand (smallest size at which R-squared is defined); fitting block larger than the number of drivers plus 1.

B2-06.guard_minimum: at least 1 malignant and 1 non-malignant patient among the held-out patients (smallest size at which AUC is defined); in each fitting set at least 2 patients per class.

B2-07.guard_minimum: at least 3 held-out rows (smallest size for a correlation) with non-zero variance of predictions and of scores.

B2-08.guard_minimum: at least 2 samples per class in every fitting set (inner and outer) and at least 1 sample in each scored set.

B2-09.guard_minimum: at least 1 sample of each class among the scored samples (AUC defined) and at least 2 per class in every fitting set.

B2-10.guard_minimum: at least 2 samples per class in every fitting set and at least 1 sample in each scored set.

B2-11.guard_minimum: at least 1 subject of each class among the scored subjects (balanced accuracy defined) and at least 2 per class in every fitting set.

B2-12.guard_minimum: at least 2 tissues per class in every fitting set and at least 1 tissue in each scored set (two classes needed for the t statistic: at least 2 per class).
B2-12.size_ratio: source states none (as read; the author's 62 x 2000 from memory is unverified)

B3-01.guard_minimum: 4 animals with at least 1 animal in each group (smallest size at which the treatment coefficient and its t statistic exist: 3 parameters, 1 residual degree of freedom); zero variance of body_mass -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-02.guard_minimum: 4 participants (partial correlation with one covariate has 1 residual degree of freedom at n = 4; n = 3 gives a perfect fit); zero variance of any variable or of a residual -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-03.guard_minimum: 4 patients (2 predictors plus intercept: 1 residual degree of freedom; the R-squared gain is defined from n = 4); zero variance of any variable -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-04.guard_minimum: 4 mice (3 parameters, 1 residual degree of freedom); zero variance of kidney_weight or collinearity making the coefficient undefined -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-05.guard_minimum: 4 skeletons (partial correlation with 1 covariate); zero variance of any variable or residual -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-06.guard_minimum: 4 trials (partial correlation with 1 covariate); fewer than 2 observers -> None; zero variance of any residual -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-08.guard_minimum: 3 patients (smallest size at which a Pearson correlation is defined); zero variance of the fall or of the second reading -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-09.guard_minimum: 3 patients (Pearson correlation); zero variance of delivery or of the uptake -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-11.guard_minimum: 4 samples (2 predictors plus intercept, 1 residual degree of freedom); zero variance -> None; non-finite -> None.

B3-12.guard_minimum: 4 months (3 parameters, 1 residual degree of freedom); zero variance of time_years or collinearity -> None; non-finite -> None.

B6-01.guard_minimum: 2 dams per group (smallest size at which the two-sample t statistic on dam means is defined); also non-finite and zero-variance guards. Same guards in both twins.

B6-02.guard_minimum: 2 wells per group (smallest size for a Welch t statistic on well proportions); at least 1 cell per well; non-finite not applicable for bool, zero-variance guard returns None. Same in both twins.

B6-03.guard_minimum: 3 animals (smallest size at which a slope t statistic with 1 df is defined); positive variance of dose; non-finite guard. Same in both twins.

B6-04.guard_minimum: 2 cages per group (smallest size at which a Welch t statistic on cage means is defined); non-finite and zero-variance guards. Same in both twins.

B6-05.guard_minimum: 2 subjects per group (smallest size for two-sample t on change scores); each within-group paired test is also defined at 2. Same guards in both twins.

B6-06.guard_minimum: 2 subjects per group and 2 sessions (a per-subject slope is defined from 2 points; the two-sample t statistic from 2 per group); zero variance of session numbers is excluded by design. Same in both twins.

B6-07.guard_minimum: 2 subjects (smallest size for a paired t statistic); zero-variance and non-finite guards. Same in both twins.

B6-08.guard_minimum: 2 tanks per group (smallest size for the Welch t statistic on tank means); non-finite and zero-variance guards. Same in both twins.
B6-08.size_ratio: tanks per treatment 4/2 = 2.0 (Hurlbert: twofold replication in such examples); samples per tank: source states none

B6-09.guard_minimum: 2 plots per group (smallest size at which the rank-sum statistic is defined for the plot means); non-finite and all-values-equal guards. Same in both twins.

B6-10.guard_minimum: 2 rats per group (smallest size for a two-sample t statistic); non-finite and zero-variance guards. Same in both twins.

B6-11.guard_minimum: 3 subjects (smallest number of pairs for which a Pearson correlation and its t statistic are defined); zero-variance and non-finite guards. Same in both twins.

B6-12.guard_minimum: 4 participants per group (smallest size at which the Fisher z standard error, with n - 3 > 0, is defined; each Pearson correlation needs 3); zero-variance and non-finite guards. Same in both twins.

O1-A.guard_minimum: 15 patients (5 folds, at least 3 rows per test fold and at least 11 training rows for 10 components plus intercept); also non-finite values and zero variance of outcome return None

O1-B.guard_minimum: 10 children with at least 2 of each diagnosis value (so that each class is present in training and test folds of a 5-fold evaluation); non-finite values return None

O2-A.guard_minimum: 2 participants per condition (smallest size at which a two-sample t statistic is defined); non-finite values and zero pooled variance return None

O2-B.guard_minimum: 2 participants per condition; non-finite values and zero pooled variance return None

O3-A.guard_minimum: 2 sensitive and 2 resistant cell lines, and at least 1 probe set on the signature; non-finite values and zero variance return None
O3-A.size_ratio: cell lines 60/60 = 1.0; probe sets 1000/12 558-22 283 = 0.045-0.080 (reduced to the cap)

O3-B.guard_minimum: 1 country-year in each debt group (difference of two means is defined from one value each); non-finite values return None
